title: Attitude vs Skill
text: the lion is not the tallest animal in the jungle he's not the strongest he's not the biggest he is not the most powerful and he's not the most intelligent and yet he's the leader why is the lion the leader because of attitude attitude comes from your belief system that belief becomes the source of his confidence and so he moves toward the other why because the Lions attitude reduces the elephant to a meal this is why he's the leader leadership is 80% attitude and 20% skill you
